title: The lantern statue that breaks and lets the spiders out
what: A rock cave shrine: a grey marble canopy over a red-carpeted dais, chains slung from its arch to a hanging wooden cage, little lamps on chains, pools of blood to either side, and two hooded grey statues holding lanterns flanking the way in. One of the statues is not stone: touch it, shoot it, or simply walk close and it shatters, the cave shakes, Caleb says something, and eleven spawn points inside it release spiders and gill beasts. Statues and canopy seen in the tour frames; the release read from the fields, not watched.
recipe: Trigger statue: face sprite tile 799 (hooded figure with lantern, 64x64 repeat, about 1.5 bodies tall), pal 1, cstat 8834, as kThingObjectGib (type 416) with trigger_push, trigger_vector, trigger_impact AND trigger_proximity, trigger_once, data1 16 (gib type), tx116 cmd on. Its twin on the other side is plain decoration. Receivers rx116 all at the statue's xy: 11 kMarkerDudeSpawn (type 18, tile 2077) stacked at z between 0.3 and 1.3 bodies above the floor, data1 213 (brown spider) x7, 214 (red spider) x2, 217 (gill beast) x3 (some only on higher skills via launch_skill); kMarkerEarthQuake (19) data1 400; kSoundPlayer (711) data1 2363. Blood pools 496 / 501: floor 0.7 body below the dais, tile 1130 (blood), each with a kMarkerUpWater (9) so they can be dived into. Cave 12 x 30 m, 3 bodies high, rock 449 / 273 walls.
use: The church: one of two saints' statues at the chapel door; the theatre: one of the plaster figures in the lobby; the harbour: a ship's figurehead in the chandlery. Proximity trigger means the player need not do anything clever, only come close.
